items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses the 'Moten band' only in response to the interviewer's question clarifying the history of the Blue Devils and Walter Page. The interviewee does not mention Benny Moton directly, nor does he describe a personal interaction or professional relationship with him, only acknowle

ctx.x: Oh yes, and he added Walter Page who he brought up from St. Louis -- not the Cotton Club, but ...
The Moten band? The way history has it is that Benny Moton had a band and Walter Page took over the Blue Devils.

The Blue Devils. Well, he got Walter Page on bass, he changed from the bass horn, and so he was forming the nucleus of the original band that was going up to the Grand Terrace, and I watched them come in night by night.
